planning.name: Mineral Investigation
planning.credit: Nearby view - not an exact stop photograph.Nearby view. Curiosity Mastcam on sol 4564 (8 June 2025, 13:57:45 UTC) of the Altadena drill hole and tailings. Sol 4564 has no separate waypoint. NASA reported a bump of less than 4 m to reach the drill block from the previous workspace. The stop coordinate is the sol 4560 waypoint.Sol 4564 | Mast Camera (Mastcam)Image credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSSOpen original source
planning.caption: Nearby view. Curiosity Mastcam on sol 4564 (8 June 2025, 13:57:45 UTC) of the Altadena drill hole and tailings. Sol 4564 has no separate waypoint. NASA reported a bump of less than 4 m to reach the drill block from the previous workspace. The stop coordinate is the sol 4560 waypoint.
